description: NON-CALIBRATED transport demonstration on sampled Unity geometry. Cropped largest wet component; shortest connected cell path from lower-Z to upper-Z boundary. 0.2 m3/s, 15 g/L and diffusivity 0.2 m2/s are test inputs, not inferred field measurements. Only cells along the path have prescribed advection; remaining wet cells mix by diffusion. Do not use as the Story river without flow review.
